title: Baatu xeex poid yu baaxul yi
intro: Ruuh bu gëm dafa juddoo ci diggante jaaykat yi ak jaaykat yi ci réew mu ñuy gëna xëcc balans yi, di wàññi nattukaay yi. Kenn kii moo taxawoon moom kese ci xeex njubadi gi réew mi àndaloon, di woo leen ñu doxal yoon, jaamu Benn Yàlla bu Dëgg bi. Doonte bataaxal bi leeroon na, te woote bi jaar na yoon, nit ñi nangu wuñu déglu, ñu daj seen musiba. Ndax mën nga xàmmee ndaw bu baax bii ci Al Quran?
clues: Dañu ma yónnee ma yónnee nit ñu bari ñuy dundee ci jënd ak jaay.
Sama askan xamoon nañu ko ci réew mi yépp ni dañuy joxe natt yu gàtt ak njuuj njaaj ci poid.
Dañu daan tiital itam ñiy tukki ci tali, di tasaare ger ci àdduna bi yépp.
Maa ngi leen di digal ñu jaamu Yàlla rekk, ba noppi ñu dëggu bu mat sëkk ci seen diggante ak nit ñi.
Dañu bañ sama kàddu, ba noppi ni dina ñu ma dàq ci réew mi, man ak ñi àndoon ak man ci gëm.
Yàlla musal na ma ak samay taalibe ci yërmaandeem, tooñkat yi am mbugël mu tar.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
